observed_failure.public_error: Musl metadata cargo failed: Fixture executable failed (exit status: 101); run the reference baseline check separately
observed_failure.diagnosis: Source-backed inference: the shared metadata capture clears HOME and CARGO_HOME, even though the build has already admitted them. Cargo can fail home discovery under a numeric container UID without a passwd home. The original Cargo stderr, actual numeric UID and passwd state were not observed, so this is not a confirmed hosted root cause.

change.scope: Musl metadata and compiler-wrapper queries only; the shared capture and all GNU/Mac helper bodies are unchanged.
preserved: Environment is cleared before installing the exact seven admitted/fixed keys; unrelated overrides and credentials remain excluded.
Existing process capture, 15-second deadline, bounded output, UTF-8 validation and sanitized errors remain in force.
No changes to SDK dependencies/pins, workflows, CPU profiles, source/archive budgets or product runtime behavior.
change.regression_scope: Synthetic closed-map and owned shell child: the old common capture fails the required-home fixture; the new Musl path succeeds while excluding overrides and enforcing the output bound. No real Cargo/SDK/provider execution in these two fixtures.

local_validation.conditions: Normal-use 16 GiB Apple Silicon Mac; Rust/Cargo 1.99.0, Node 22.14.0; locked offline Cargo, two jobs, debug information and incremental compilation disabled. The current auditor was freshly linked, with dependencies reused from the one existing correctness cache; this is not a cold whole-product build.
local_validation.ownership: Each phase retained before/after source, frozen and auxiliary guards, finite wall/output limits, direct-child waits and process-group cleanup. These observations do not establish universal descendant or crash/cancel cleanup.
local_validation.postterminal_publication: The two new public summaries, evidence-index entries and status prose are published after the completed validation cohort. Completed owners retain their original source/AUX snapshots; they are not rebound to later documentation bytes.

limits: Fresh hosted execution is required to confirm the home-discovery diagnosis and both real Musl producers. The preceding hosted failures remain failures.
No original successful Musl provenance pair has yet been collected or independently verified.
SDK mocks and shell fixtures are separate from actual signed SDK installation and native execution; local mock timing is not model or platform performance.

This evidence does not qualify minimum OS/CPU/kernel, TLS, WSL, PTY, reproducible builds, representative hardware, live task quality, the complete twelve-target release set or production release integration.
JavaScript 0.5.2 remains the shipping default; ordinary native TLS remains Rustls. No release, merge or default cutover is authorized by this checkpoint.
